video_title: Deron Williams on if he'd rather win a NBA championship or a MVP 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Debating the value of individual accolades versus winning an NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: Some people just go right to ring, rings. It goes with what you want as a player.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I see what he's saying. It goes with what we're talking about because we always look at accolades first, individual accolades, tiebreaker, championship. But it goes with what you want as a player for yourself. Some people may say, I want to be MVP, I want more individual accolades. Some people might say, I want a ring. I want to see how many rings I can get.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Every player is not the same. All of us on this couch are not the same.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing the career value of Russell Westbrook and Clay Thompson
quotes.excerpt: Would you rather have Russell Westbrook's career with the MVP, triple-doubles all that, or Clay Thompson?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Would you rather have Russell Westbrook's career with the MVP, triple-doubles all that, or Clay Thompson?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Clay Thompson's critical role in the Golden State Warriors' championships
quotes.excerpt: If they don't have Clay, they don't win those championships.
quotes.quote: If they don't have Clay, they don't win those championships. He's a pivotal part, like beyond pivotal. They were the Splash Brothers. Clay was an All-Star. We're talking about a perennial All-Star. So yeah, I'm taking Clay. All-Star, ring, and defensively he was nice.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Choosing between winning a championship and individual MVP honors
quotes.excerpt: I would pick the rings. I'm just putting it for the other perspective.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: You went to North Carolina to win a championship, right? So for you, winning has always been important. So for you, would you rather be a max player than Robert Horry?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I would pick the rings. I'm just putting it for the other perspective.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Russell Westbrook's competitive integrity throughout his NBA career
quotes.excerpt: Russ never cheated the game. He competed to win.
quotes.quote: This is another credit to Russ. Russ never cheated the game. Russ never went out there trying to lose. He competed to win. It's not like he didn't try to go win.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of winning an MVP award in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Derrick Rose and Russell Westbrook won the MVP in the NBA when it was a gauntlet.
quotes.quote: You got to think about Derrick Rose and Russell Westbrook won the MVP in the NBA when it was a gauntlet to get that motherfucker. It was a gauntlet to get that motherfucker.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Prioritizing an MVP award over championship rings as a player
quotes.excerpt: I would take the MVP. I'm the best in the world, dog.
quotes.quote: I would take the MVP. I'm the best in the world, dog.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash's MVP selection versus Kobe Bryant's overall player value
quotes.excerpt: Steve Nash was the most valuable to the Phoenix Suns because they were winning.
quotes.quote: Steve Nash was the most valuable to the Phoenix Suns because they were winning, but he wasn't the best player that year. Kobe Bryant was a better player than him.
